evals.name: ash-interactive-login-check
evals.prompt: abre el navegador en localhost:5173 y fijate si el login de ASH funciona
evals.expected_output: The agent checks the dev server on https://localhost:5173, logs in as ASH via official UI controls (#id locators), and verifies session initialization via window.__VITE_DEBUG__.
assertions: Uses https://localhost:5173 for interactive browser QA
Logs in as ASH through the UI /login view without skipping via evaluate

evals.name: mobile-combat-viewport-qa
evals.prompt: chequea manualmente en el navegador si la pantalla de combate se ve bien en mobile
evals.expected_output: The agent uses project-browser-testing protocols on localhost:5173 with mobile viewport settings and official UI controls.

evals.name: populate-tester-bag-inventory
evals.prompt: llena mi mochila con objetos de prueba (pociones, piedras evolutivas, caramelos raros) para probar el inventario en el navegador
